input.basis: Yahoo quote OHLC; no AdjClose mixing
input.extraction: SPY rows directly from hash-verified fixed prices.json.gz; no new requests

definitions.asOf: previous SPY session close, including the first evaluation day
definitions.capture: ratio of geometric mean DAILY returns on positive/negative raw SPY price days
definitions.drawdown: both chronologically stitched selected days and separate contiguous episodes
definitions.fixedMeanWeight: ex-post control, not a point-in-time trading signal
